title: Expected Neighbor Response
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with a finite, nonempty neighbor set at each vertex, and let a long-code table assign a Boolean function to each vertex. For every vertex $v$ and query $x\in\{\pm1\}^q$, the uniform expectation over neighbors $w$ of the real sign value returned by the table at the permuted query equals the averaged neighbor function at $v$ evaluated at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ of dimension $q$
A long-code table on the vertices of $G$
The neighbor set at the vertex is finite and nonempty
